description: a young village herbalist woman with long light brown braids, a green linen dress and a brown shawl, sunk waist-deep in black marsh mud with dark water around her, both arms reaching out for help, a wicker basket of herbs floating beside her on the water, muddy and frightened, the whole figure and the mud around her inside the image, three-quarter view, isolated on a plain background, muted forest colours

references.usage: the woman's face, hair and clothes: she is this herbalist
